assessments.reasoning: Event 47bca22f41744b39b938dd80de3a06bc, Mozilla archive, MPL 1.0 governing revision 1, [5868,6711). Section 3.2 states the recipients, routes and duration. Sections 1.4, 1.5, 1.9 and 1.11 define the relevant mechanism and forms of code.

challenge.method: Tested a private modification with no Executable recipient, unrelated files in a Larger Work, and an electronic host that removes the source early.
challenge.results: The clause identifies recipients by Executable availability and material by the defined Modification. It supplies no general public-posting requirement. A third-party host leaves You responsible for continued availability.

limitations: Electronic availability must continue for at least 12 months after initial availability, or at least six months after a subsequent version of that particular Modification is made available to those recipients. Section 4 separately addresses statutory or regulatory impossibility.
reasoning: MPL 1.0 §3.2 requires You to make Modifications You create or contribute to available under the license in Source Code form to anyone to whom You made an Executable version available. It specifies the same media as the Executable or an accepted Electronic Distribution Mechanism.
